apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.

Tier 3 under the CEO rule (7.10.2026): listing-site rents left in the body. Apply AFTER tier 1 and tier 2 (both are live on this page), on the live content, in the listed order. ceo_action: replaced = the CBS value (table 4.9, Q2 2026) now stands there, with its source_url; removed = number gone, sentence or cell kept; deleted = sentence, row, column or paragraph gone. Whole elements deleted with their tags (paragraph) carry the tags in 'old'.
notes: The official price list is not on this page yet; the edits align the body with it in advance. 5 rooms has no median for 10-12.2025 or 1-3.2026, so every 5-room figure is the latest published, 7-9.2025 (1,766,500), with its year-earlier quarter 7-9.2024 (1,846,700), written as such in the text and the table. Not audited as claims: sizes (50-191 m2, 87 / 109 m2), 3.5 rooms in the deals table, the CBS release number and date (p@20130), counts of deals or weeks in advice (5-10 deals, 5 deals, 2-4 weeks). Rents are kept: the page labels them as asking rents from listings (628 active listings at one check) and dates its check (6.6.2026); the lead and the source statement now call them listing figures. The deals table (six dated deals, April-May 2025) is kept; the 860,000 / 1,100,000 deals in p@8807 are the same dated deals, and edit 5 adds their month to the sentence. The three remaining check.py SUSPECTs are these individual dated deals (p@8807 twice, the 8.5.2025 row of the deals table). Name mapping: 'שכונה ב/ד/ה' = official 'ב', 'ד', 'ה'; 'אזור תעשיה' exact; Neve Menachem, Shchuna Tet, Alef and Gimel are not in the city file (the city file keeps only 8 neighbourhoods; the official files DO hold 1-3.2026 medians for some of the others (checked 7.10.2026), so these rows say 'לא מוצג במחירון' (not shown in the page's list), never 'לא פורסם'). Official medians also exist for שכונה ו and שכונה יא, which the table does not list; not added. The page writes m2 as 'מ״ר' (gershayim) and the currency as ₪; the new text follows.

edits.old: מחירי דירות בבאר שבע נעים בדרך כלל סביב 616,000-650,000 ₪ לדירות 2 חדרים, כ-800,000-832,000 ₪ לדירות 3 חדרים, כ-1.19-1.22 מיליון ₪ לדירות 4 חדרים, כ-1.86-1.89 מיליון ₪ לדירות 5 חדרים, וכ-2.53-2.59 מיליון ₪ בדירות 6 חדרים ומעלה, לפי שילוב של נתוני עסקאות וביקוש. מחיר ממוצע בעיר עומד סביב 1.18 מיליון ₪, מחיר ממוצע למ״ר סביב 11,900 ₪, ושכירות מבוקשת נעה לרוב מכ-2,300 ₪ לדירת 2 חדרים, כ-2,600-2,760 ₪ לדירת 3 חדרים, כ-3,170-3,640 ₪ לדירת 4 חדרים וכ-4,750-5,740 ₪ לדירת 5 חדרים.
edits.new: מחירי דירות בבאר שבע, לפי נתוני רשות המסים: חציון מחיר העסקה ברבעון הראשון של 2026 היה 808,800 ₪ לדירת 3 חדרים ו-1,203,200 ₪ לדירת 4 חדרים, ולדירת 5 חדרים 1,766,500 ₪ ברבעון השלישי של 2025 (הנתון האחרון שפורסם לדירות 5 חדרים). חציון מחיר העסקה לכל הדירות בעיר ברבעון הראשון של 2026 היה 1,153,400 ₪. בשכירות, המחיר המבוקש במודעות נע לרוב מכ-2,300 ₪ לדירת 2 חדרים, כ-2,600-2,760 ₪ לדירת 3 חדרים, כ-3,170-3,640 ₪ לדירת 4 חדרים וכ-4,750-5,740 ₪ לדירת 5 חדרים.

The 2-room and 6+-room ranges and the 11,900 per-m2 average carry only 'a combination of deal and demand data' and are dropped; the asking rents (listings, page checked 6.6.2026) are kept and labelled as listing asks. The rest of the paragraph is untouched.
